title: Unable to execute CLI commands
body:
## Summary
Claude code seems very capable of reading files, and writing files however when it attempts to execute any CLI command(echo 'tod'), it simply hangs waiting for the result. The time does continue to tick up however.

## Environment
- ZSH CLI with Zim.
- MacOSX.
author: Francismb

top_comments.author: wolffiex
top_comments.body: can you provide the zsh executable location on your system?

top_comments.author: wolffiex
top_comments.body: can folks who are still having trouble please post the location of bash or zsh on your system? If you're having problems with version 0.2.32, it means we can't find bash or zsh using `which` your $SHELL env var or by looking in our usual spots
